name: Hostile Takeover
summary: In Booty Bay, Gelriz's latest move draws Baron Revilgaz's wrath in Hostile Takeover. Gelriz has pushed aside moguls appointed by the trade princes and now moves against the most notorious pirate of all. Kebok sends you to steal strange blue crystals Venture Company geologists have found near Lake Nazferiti.

sections.title: A Matter of Business
sections.body: Baron Revilgaz gives Kebok leave to answer the insult as he sees fit. Kebok chooses theft, targeting the strange blue stones Venture Company mining crews have been unearthing.

sections.title: The Geologists' Cache
sections.body: Venture Company geologists working around Lake Nazferiti have taken a keen interest in the unusual crystals. Kebok wants you to bring eight samples back to Booty Bay. How you get them matters little to him, so long as they end up in his hands.

sections.title: A Tumbling Discovery
sections.body: The returned crystals have been tumbled, suggesting the Venture Company means to use them as fuel or an industrial catalyst. Kebok plans to send samples to Head Chemist Gigglefont for closer study.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Hostile Takeover?
faq.answer: Kebok, in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale, gives you this assignment on Baron Revilgaz's behalf.

faq.q: Why is Baron Revilgaz angry with Gelriz?
faq.answer: Gelriz pushed aside moguls appointed by the trade princes and has now moved against the most notorious pirate. Baron Revilgaz will not tolerate it.
Venture Company geologists working around Lake Nazferiti carry the crystals.
